Carry-chain and XOR/ADD sequences can appear in multi-precision arithmetic or hash-like routines, but they also appear in ordinary compiler-generated code. No function names, API calls or strings were provided to corroborate a mining workload. The model's confidence is very high, but the supplied evidence supports only a suspicious, inconclusive assessment.
